tools.name: check_blacklist
tools.description: Check an IP address against 24 IP blacklists (Spamhaus ZEN, Barracuda, SpamCop and more), OR check a domain against the domain blacklists (Spamhaus DBL etc). A domain check tests the DOMAIN itself only - to check a specific sending IP, pass that IP. Free tool by Postbox Services.

tools.name: check_spoofability
tools.description: Grade how exposed a domain is to email spoofing and business email compromise, from its public DNS (SPF, DMARC policy strength, alignment, live lookalike domains). Returns an A-F grade with findings. Free tool by Postbox Services.

tools.name: trace_redirect
tools.description: Follow a URL server-side through every HTTP redirect hop to its real final destination - per-hop status, IP, TLS and timing, plus phishing/deliverability flags (cross-domain jumps, https downgrades, meta/JS redirects). Free tool by Postbox Services.

tools.name: create_mailtest
tools.description: Create a disposable test address for a full email deliverability audit (score /10: SPF, DKIM, DMARC + alignment, blacklists, reverse DNS, SpamAssassin content, Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender compliance). The USER must then send an email from the system they want to test to the returned address, after which

tools.name: get_mailtest_result
tools.description: Fetch the score and breakdown of a mail test created with create_mailtest, once the user has sent their email to the disposable address.

tools.name: analyze_eml
tools.description: Run a deliverability/content analysis on a raw RFC 822 email (.eml source: full headers + body). IMPORTANT LIMITS: with no live SMTP session, SPF, blacklist and reverse-DNS cannot be verified from a file - for the authoritative score use create_mailtest instead. Free tool by Postbox Services.

tools.name: get_domain_age
tools.description: Get a domain's registration date and age (young domains have weak sending reputation). Free tool by Postbox Services.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: WHOIS summary for a domain: registrar, created/updated/expires dates, nameservers, DNSSEC, status flags. Free tool by Postbox Services.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_spoofability, get_mailtest_result · Private data: analyze_eml · Public sink: check_spoofability, create_mailtest, get_mailtest_result, analyze_eml · Destructive: analyze_eml.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_spoofability, get_mailtest_result · Private data: analyze_eml · Public sink: check_spoofability, create_mailtest, get_mailtest_result, analyze_eml · Destructive: analyze_eml

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
